title: Sleep, Focus, and When to Seek Help
summary: Difficulty sleeping, scattered attention, nail-biting, constant fatigue—these may be signs of ADHD, anxiety, or depression. A consistent sleep routine (9–11 hours), dividing tasks, and immediate rewards can help. If symptoms persist for weeks and affect school or home life: consult a pediatrician or psychiatrist.
try_this: This week: A fixed sleep schedule (same time every night, no screens an hour before bed, reading or relaxation). Observe: Has their focus improved in the morning?
reflection_prompts: Have you noticed an improvement in their focus or mood?
warning_flags: تأثير على الأداء الدراسي أو العلاقات
